purpose: Correct rear-facing head so no eyes are visible.

arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the selected transparent shark sprite to edit. Image 2 is the exact original SLEVEJM2 001 pose and action. Image 3 is the established gray-shark identity and ink/cel-shading reference only. Correct only the head orientation and eye area: this shark has his back to the viewer and his head is turned away toward screen-right. NO EYES are visible from this rear three-quarter angle. Remove every eye, pupil, white sclera, eyelid and eyebrow from Image 1, and redraw that area as a smooth continuous medium-gray back/top-of-head plane with restrained cel shading. Do not replace the eye with a closed-eye line. Do not add a far-side eye. Keep the existing compact toothy mouth, snout direction, raised far pectoral-fin gesture, hanging near pectoral fin, dorsal fin, body silhouette, waterline, proportions, colors and bold black line style unchanged. Image 2 is pose truth; do not reinterpret its mouth/fin pixels as an eye. Preserve clear margins and genuine transparent RGBA. No background, checkerboard, glow, shadow, text or extra anatomy.
